steps.summary: Signed in as admin at http://127.0.0.1:8069/, navigated to the Contacts app, searched first to confirm no existing 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer' record (search returned the empty state, so no duplicate was created), then created a new contact with Name 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer' and City 'Benchville' (all other fields left default, Company Type = Company) and saved it. The saved record (id=46) shows the heading and Name field 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer', City 'Benchville', a "Contact created" system notification, and the browser title "Odoo - fwod20-n3 Bench Customer".

The quotation form was still unsaved (title 'New') with customer 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer' and one line for 'Customizable Desk' at quantity 1.00. I set the quantity to 3 and saved. The saved record S00023 (id=23) shows: customer 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer'; one order line with product 'Customizable Desk' [FURN_0096], quantity 3.00, unit price 750.00, tax 20%, tax-excl. £ 2,250.00; and Untaxed Amount £ 2,250.00 (TAX 20% £ 450.00, Total £ 2,700.00). Status remains 'Quotation' — not confirmed, and no extra lines were added.

Added a second order line to draft quotation S00023 (customer 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer'). The new line is product 'Conference Chair' [E-COM12] at quantity 2.00, unit price £ 33.00. The first line (Customizable Desk, qty 3) was kept unchanged. After saving, the Untaxed Amount is £ 2,316.00 (2,250 + 66). Quotation status remains 'Quotation' — not confirmed.

Changed the first order line's quantity from 3 to 5 (product Customizable Desk) on draft quotation S00023. The second line (Conference Chair, qty 2) was left unchanged. After saving: first line quantity confirmed as 5.00, and the Untaxed Amount is £ 3,816.00 (5 × £750 + 2 × £33 = £3,750 + £66). Quotation remains unconfirmed.

Confirmed the draft quotation S00023 for customer 'fwod20-n3 Bench Customer' (2 lines: Customizable Desk qty 5, Conference Chair qty 2). After confirmation: the order reference remains S00023, and the status bar now shows 'Sales Order' (checked, disabled) — the quotation has been converted to a confirmed sales order.

Closed the 'Edit: fwod20-n3 Bench Customer' dialog by Discarding it (no changes saved). Then clicked Cancel on the Cancel dialog, which showed a confirmation alert "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?" which was accepted. The sales order S00023 is now cancelled — the Statusbar radiogroup shows Cancelled (checked/disabled), with Sales Order and Quotation options disabled. No Recipients issue occurred.

Opened the Contacts app and found the record for fwod20-n3 Bench Customer (already shown on page). The saved record displays: Name = "fwod20-n3 Bench Customer" (in the H1 heading and the Name field), City = "Benchville". Company Type is "Company" (default). No changes were made to the record.
